subject: Music Production
subcategory: Iconic Albums and How They Were Made
title: Adele's 21
description: A fast breakdown of Adele's 21 for builders.

hook.text: After a painful breakup, twenty-one-year-old Adele poured her heartbreak into a sophomore album.

buildup.text: Producer Paul Epworth built 'Rolling in the Deep' around a stomping beat and Adele's powerful vocal.

discovery.text: The production was intentionally sparse, placing Adele's voice front and center on every track.

twist.text: In the age of Auto-Tune and electronic pop, a raw vocal album became the decade's biggest seller.

climax.text: 21 sold over thirty-one million copies worldwide and won six Grammy Awards.

punchline.text: A breakup album outsold the entire pop industry.

quiz.question: What production approach defined Adele's 21?
options: Sparse production placing her voice front and center
